selector.rationale: The presence of a rapidly growing, ulcerated, pedunculated mass with anaplastic cells and positive reactivity to melanocytic markers supports Malignant Melanoma of the Caruncle, which is further strengthened by the absence of PAM and negative sentinel lymph node biopsy findings.

rejected.label: Conjunctival Melanoma
rejected.why: Lack of evidence supporting conjunctival involvement and presence of contradiction in AX_SE004

rejected.label: Anaplastic Melanoma
rejected.why: While anaplastic features are present, they are not sufficient to override the more specific diagnosis of Malignant Melanoma of the Caruncle
